title: 24:14 They shall lift up their voice/cry shrilly. The righteous who remain will lift up their voice—a phrase often associated with prayer (Gen. 21:16) and song (42:11). When the Lord comes, all "who remain, even from the least unto the greatest . . . shall be filled with the knowledge of the Lord, and shall see eye to eye, and shall lift up their voice, and with the voice together sing this new song" (D&C 84:98). The words to the song are found in D&C 84:99-102.
author: Tina M. Peterson
